TrueHD test streams for the decoder package's tests (src/package.rs), copied unmodified from the WebGPU player's
wgpud/truehd/vectors/ at v0.5.0 (https://github.com/AIOStreams/WebGPU-Player, commit 1bc0286cdda53aa286f0544dcc0fe91ed8889009),
whose PROVENANCE.txt describes them:

- fba_atmos_obj.mlp and fba_atmos_cbi.mlp: from truehd/tests/assets/ of https://github.com/truehdd/truehdd at commit
  77ddc52e6ab41c59d8964cfe8e44140afa82342c, under the Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-truehdd, that commit's licence file).
  140 access units; its 16-channel presentation is one LFE bed channel and 15 dynamic objects, all silent, with object
  audio metadata in access units 0, 38, 76 and 115. fba_atmos_cbi.mlp: 136 access units; its 16-channel presentation is a
  channel bed without object metadata. Both are silent and have major syncs at access units 0 and 128.
